status: frozen before any Joint-v2 U test inference
exploratory_status: Joint-v2 is an exploratory follow-up motivated by Joint-v1 failure modes; Joint-v1 U results were viewed before v2 was designed, so v2 is not an untouched unseen evaluation.

split_execution_queues.atomic_job: per split: fit split-specific PCA -> initialize from scratch -> train 100 epochs -> Seen-val checkpoint and threshold -> only then test inference

architecture.inheritance: Joint-v1 Moment-DETR transformer and localization branch, phrase-slot matcher, candidate-conditioned phrase attention, candidate-wise gated phrase refinement, semantic evidence-aware existence head, smooth logsumexp pooling, TRM losses, S+/S- training, Seen-only MR-full-mAP selection, Seen-only balanced-accuracy calibration, official soft gate, diagnostic hard gate
architecture.semantic_candidate_evidence: existing MLP([h_j, base_margin_j, refined_margin_j, phrase_support_j, phrase_gate_j])
architecture.visual_evidence: raw visual candidate mean pool -> background-PCA orthogonal residual norm -> background residual standardization -> tanh
architecture.fusion: q_fused_j = q_sem_j + softplus(alpha_visual_raw) * candidate_visual_support.detach(); fused logit uses smooth logsumexp

visual_feature_protocol.source: dataset video features before input_vid_proj and before text interaction
visual_feature_protocol.normalization: existing dataset preprocessing L2-normalizes each modality row-wise per clip before concatenation
visual_feature_protocol.temporal_indexing: reuse dataset integer clip convention: floor(start/clip_length), end-exclusive int(end/clip_length), clipped to valid sequence length

background_pca.data_access: directly load only train S+ video visual NPZ arrays and vid/relevant_windows metadata; do not instantiate text/phrase dataset path or load query/phrase features
background_pca.sampling: clip-level raw visual vectors strictly outside union of GT relevant_windows
background_pca.algorithm: sklearn IncrementalPCA; stable covariance eigendecomposition fallback if sklearn is unavailable

training_hyperparameters.sampler: existing DataLoader shuffle=True, no balanced sampler
training_hyperparameters.loss: Joint-v1 L_span + L_giou + L_label + 1.0 L_phrase_consistency + 0.5 L_phrase_negative + 1.0 L_phrase_exclusiveness + 1.0 L_exist_BCE + 0.5 L_auc_pairwise

auc_objective.name: loss_auc_pairwise
auc_objective.definition: mean(softplus(auc_margin - (s_pos[:,None] - s_neg[None,:]))) over all within-batch pairs

selection_and_threshold.existence_threshold: Seen validation S+/S- maximum balanced accuracy = 0.5*(TPR+TNR)

test_protocol.inference_order: after best checkpoint and Seen-only threshold are frozen, run full test S+/S-/U+/U- inference
test_protocol.also_check: full-precision probability AUROC must match logit AUROC or inference raises
test_protocol.machine_readable_precision: Python/full float precision for existence logits, probabilities, candidate evidence, visual residual/support
